verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents and runtime-verifies a CLI with a 'delete' command and a REST API with delete operations, plus webhooks firing on delete events, giving a platform engineer a way to remove memories. However, there's no explicit documentation of bulk 'erase all memories for user_id' or per-entity cascading delete semantics — memory-expiration is explicitly non-destructive ('Nothing is deleted'), so full/verified privacy-erasure workflows are only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit docs for user-level bulk/cascade delete endpoint, entity-wide erasure confirmation, and compliance-oriented deletion guarantees (e.g., audit of physical data removal).
